newsitem.title: USA: Chattem sees year EPS, revenues up.
newsitem.headline: Chattem sees year EPS, revenues up.

text.p: Chattem Inc said Friday it believes that the strategic positioning of the company which took place in 1995 and 1996 combined with the increased marketing efforts being implemented in 1997 should result in growth in earnings and sales in excess of that achieved in 1996.
The foundation built in 1997 should provide the opportunity for continued expansion in the following years, Chattem said.

Earlier, the company reported earnings from continuing operations for 1996 of $3,804,000 or $0.47 per share, up from $2,325,000 or $0.32 per share in 1995. Sales were $118.9 million, up from $100.6 million.
